items.title: France Moves Budget Vote Carrying Stablecoin Tax to Nov. 3
items.summary: The proposal would end tax deferral on gains from swaps into single-currency stablecoins from January 2027.

items.title: France's parliament approves vote to hit stablecoin trades with 31% capital gains tax
items.summary: Amendment I-3898 removes tax deferral for MiCA-compliant stablecoins starting January 2027.

items.title: Netflix FTX trailer was ‘enough to upset me’ in first 30 seconds: former FTX COO
items.summary: Constance Wang criticized the streamer’s portrayal of her former FTX colleagues as not matching her own experience with Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison.

items.title: Mt. Gox Pushes Repayment Deadline to 2027 With $2.8B in Bitcoin Still to Distribute
items.summary: The defunct exchange's trustee said many creditors still have not completed the procedures needed to get their Bitcoin back.
